classification.difficultyReason: Read seven integer coordinate pairs from a unit Cartesian grid, including points on the axes.

content.prompt: Find the coordinates of each of the points $A$ to $G$ below.

spec.description: Equal-scale Cartesian grid from −5 to 5 in each direction, positive-end axis arrows, no axis titles, and seven labelled red points. Coordinates are graphical givens only.
spec.mathematics: Unit grid; A=(4,4), B=(-4,3), C=(-4,-3), D=(3,-3), E=(1,1), F=(0,-4), G=(-2,0). Horizontal ticks labelled −4 to 4; vertical nonzero ticks labelled −4 to 4; one origin 0.
spec.answerVisibility: Given points and labels remain visible in every edition; coordinate answers appear only in answer content.

answer.worked: 4 units right and 4 units up from the origin: $A(4,4)$.
4 units left and 3 units up from the origin: $B(-4,3)$.
4 units left and 3 units down from the origin: $C(-4,-3)$.
3 units right and 3 units down from the origin: $D(3,-3)$.
1 unit right and 1 unit up from the origin: $E(1,1)$.
The point is on the vertical axis, 4 units below the origin: $F(0,-4)$.
The point is on the horizontal axis, 2 units left of the origin: $G(-2,0)$.
